content.short: POAP, the Proof of Attendance Protocol, turns event attendance and memories into collectible NFTs.
content.description: POAP (Proof of Attendance Protocol) lets event organisers and communities issue collectible badges to the people who took part, creating a verifiable record of memories. Collectors can browse galleries and curated collections, and builders can use the data. Blockscout's Unichain app marketplace lists POAP.
content.meta: POAP issues collectible proof-of-attendance badges for events and communities, listed for Unichain.
